test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: For a group of 50 male workers, the mean and the standard deviation of their daily wages are Rs. 63 and Rs. 9, respectively. For a group of 40 female workers, these values are Rs. 54 and Rs. 6, respectively. What is the standard deviation of the combined group of these 90 workers?
solution:
The correct answer is** 9.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Combined Standard Deviation:

__
 
• Step-by-Step Calculation: To find the standard deviation of the combined group, we need to use the formula for the combined standard deviation of two groups.
 
• The formula takes into account the means and standard deviations of the individual groups, as well as their sizes.
 
• Using the formula: sigma꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd = sqrt{frac{(n₁-1)sigma₁² + (n₂-1)sigma₂² + n₁ (mu₁ - mu꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd)² + n₂ (mu₂ - mu꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd)²}{n₁ + n₂ - 1}} 
 
• Where μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2" id="MathJax-Element-335-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2" id="MathJax-Element-82-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2" id="MathJax-Element-15-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2
 μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2
 μcombined=n1μ1+n2μ2n1+n2 \mu_{combined} = \frac{n_1\mu_1 + n_2\mu_2}{n_1 + n_2} .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 Let's calculate step-by-step:

 
• Mean of combined group: mu꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd = (50 times 63 + 40 times 54)/(50 + 40) = 59 
 
• Variance of male workers: sigma₁² = 9² = 81 
 
• Variance of female workers: sigma₂² = 6² = 36 
 
• Combined variance: sigma꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd² = (49 times 81 + 39 times 36 + 50 times (63 - 59)² + 40 times (54 - 59)²)/(89) 
 
• Combined standard deviation: sigma꜀ₒₘbᵢₙₑd = sqrt{81} = 9 

Hence, the standard deviation of the combined group of 90 workers is 9.
